prompt_preview:
Below is an RFP, split into numbered blocks. Each block shows its ID, type and RFP section.

TASK: list every requirement the client places on the consultant or on the proposal.

CATEGORIES (use exactly one):
- "Scope": work or activities the consultant must carry out
- "Deliverable": tangible outpu

requirements.requirement: Complete the full engagement within 16 weeks from commencement.
requirements.source_quote: The appointed consultant shall complete the full engagement within 16 weeks from the official commencement date.

requirements.requirement: Benchmark the group's AI maturity against at least three regional and global logistics peers.
requirements.source_quote: the consultant shall benchmark the group's AI maturity against at least three regional and global logistics peers.

requirements.requirement: Assess the current AI and analytics maturity of all five business units.
requirements.source_quote: the consultant shall thoroughly assess the current AI and analytics maturity of all five business units (Ports, Freight, Warehousing, Customs Brokerage, Corporate Services).

requirements.requirement: Assess the readiness of data infrastructure and data governance including ownership, quality, and policies.
requirements.source_quote: the consultant shall assess the readiness of the group's data infrastructure and its data governance, encompassing data ownership, data quality standards, and data policies.

requirements.requirement: Identify at least 20 AI use cases and prioritise them by value and feasibility with financial estimates.
requirements.source_quote: the consultant shall identify at least 20 AI use cases and prioritise them by business value and feasibility, with an estimated financial impact for each.

requirements.requirement: Design an AI target operating model, including an AI Centre of Excellence, roles, and decision rights.
requirements.source_quote: The consultant shall design an AI target operating model, including an AI Centre of Excellence, key roles, and decision rights.

requirements.requirement: Develop a Responsible AI framework aligned with the UAE's national AI ethics principles.
requirements.source_quote: The consultant shall develop a Responsible AI framework aligned with the UAE's national AI ethics principles.

requirements.requirement: Design a change management and AI upskilling programme for approximately 500 employees.
requirements.source_quote: The consultant shall design a change management and AI upskilling programme reaching approximately 500 employees.

requirements.requirement: Deliver two proof-of-concept pilots for top-priority use cases.
requirements.source_quote: The consultant shall deliver two proof-of-concept pilots for top-priority use cases.

requirements.requirement: Mobilise the team and hold the project kick-off within two weeks of contract signature.
requirements.source_quote: The consultant shall mobilise the team and hold the project kick-off within two weeks of contract signature.

requirements.requirement: Hold an interim Steering Committee review at week 8 to evaluate preliminary findings and adjustments.
requirements.source_quote: the consultant shall hold an interim Steering Committee review at week 8 to evaluate preliminary findings, review initial use-case prioritisation, and adjust project trajectories as necessary.

requirements.requirement: Provide all final deliverables in both Arabic and English.
requirements.source_quote: All final deliverables provided in both Arabic and English.

requirements.requirement: Deliver a current-state assessment report detailing maturity across all operational domains.
requirements.source_quote: The mandated outputs must include a current-state assessment report detailing maturity across all operational domains

requirements.requirement: Provide a prioritised AI use-case portfolio.
requirements.source_quote: alongside a prioritised AI use-case portfolio.

requirements.requirement: Formulate a three-year AI roadmap including investment estimates by year.
requirements.source_quote: the consultant shall formulate a three-year AI roadmap including investment estimates by year.

requirements.requirement: Deliver a final presentation to the Executive Board summarising the strategy, governance, and pilot outcomes.
requirements.source_quote: a final presentation to the Executive Board, summarising the strategic roadmap, governance models, and pilot outcomes.

requirements.requirement: Include detailed company profiles in the proposal submission.
requirements.source_quote: submissions must contain detailed company profiles

requirements.requirement: Demonstrate logistics sector experience in the proposal.
requirements.source_quote: demonstrable logistics sector experience

requirements.requirement: Include comprehensive methodological approaches within the proposal.
requirements.source_quote: and comprehensive methodological approaches.

requirements.requirement: Provide CVs of the proposed team, including at least two Arabic-speaking consultants.
requirements.source_quote: the consultant shall provide CVs of the proposed team, including at least two Arabic-speaking consultants.

requirements.requirement: Provide fixed-fee pricing broken down by project phase.
requirements.source_quote: Bidders must also provide fixed-fee pricing broken down by project phase.

skipped_sections.reason: Contains evaluation criteria and scoring weights.
Contains submission logistics, submission deadlines, and clarification question procedures.
